checkedAlternates.risk: During a transit, Venus passes in front of the Sun.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Venus covers only a tiny dot on the solar disk, classified as a planetary transit (group-1) rather than a solar eclipse (group-3).
Lunar occultation occurs when the Moon passes in front of a distant star or planet (group-4), not Earth’s shadow (group-2).
